scientific_integrity: The point-process theorem is proved by exact parent-choice generating functions, a uniform marked rare-event estimate, and mixed factorial moments; numerical and finite enumerations are supplementary. Same-model review only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed offspring degrees and fixed finite collections; no growing-degree uniformity.
No finite-n independence or convergence-rate assertion.
Historical-priority uncertainty remains for inaccessible older degree-process literature.
title: Logarithmically separated Poisson birth frontiers for fixed offspring degrees
